primer: AXISCADES Technologies is selling staffing units to Akkodis for ~$237 million across phases to focus on defense electronics, CNC tooling, and AI liquid cooling. Yet FY26 free cash flow plunged to -₹135 crore as debtor days reached 130 and payables doubled from 100 to 220 days. Only 57% of Akkodis cash arrives in Year 1, and shares sit in Stage 3 at ₹1,918.30 with -25.87% 28-day relative strength. With probability-weighted fair value at ₹1,954.00 (+1.86%), our new-capital verdict is REJECTED (TIER_0, 0% allocation).
